insights.summary: FY26 revenue doubled to ₹148 Cr (+108%), with EBITDA of ₹33 Cr (22.5%) and net profit of ₹21 Cr (14%); H2 FY26 alone was ₹106 Cr, up 164%, as CCTV sales jumped after STQC rules barred uncertified foreign camera brands. Display products (TVs, panels) fell 51% in H2. Growth has been funded by working capital and debt: operating cash flow was only ₹0.3 Cr, receivables and inventory rose sharply, and short-term borrowings went from ₹2.8 Cr to ₹31.8 Cr. The company holds no earnings calls and gives no numeric guidance.

what_changed.text: BIS-ER certification through STQC-accredited labs, as STQC rules shut out uncertified (mainly Chinese) brands
In-house SMT line for PCBs (50 lakh units a year) and housing moulding at Gandhinagar
PRIZOR PLUS AI camera series (face recognition, number-plate reading)
Display products revenue fell 51% in H2 FY26 as focus moved to cameras

tone.label: confident
tone.quote: This is not a cyclical shift. It is structural, and it is irreversible

red_flags.text: Operating cash flow of ₹0.3 Cr against ₹21 Cr of net profit; receivables up from ₹15.7 Cr to ₹38.6 Cr and inventory from ₹28.5 Cr to ₹50 Cr.
Short-term borrowings rose from ₹2.8 Cr to ₹31.8 Cr in a year.
New ₹10 Cr long-term loans and advances and ₹12 Cr of intangible assets under development, with no explanation in the deck.
Growth rides a one-time regulatory switch (STQC); the chairman's quote calls the H2 numbers 'H1 FY26 results'.
No earnings calls and no guidance, so management can't be held to targets.
